title: First Non-Repeating Character in a Stream
description:
Characters arrive one at a time. After each arrival, report the first character (in arrival order) that has appeared exactly once so far, or # if there is none.

Input format
Line 1: a string of lowercase letters (the stream, in arrival order).

Output format
A string of the same length: its i-th character is the answer after the i-th arrival.
hints: After each new character you need the earliest character that is still unique. What structure keeps things in arrival order?
Keep a queue of characters in arrival order and a count per letter. When a character's count reaches 2 it can no longer be the answer.
After updating the counts, pop characters from the FRONT of the queue while their count is more than 1. Then the front (if any) is the answer; if the queue is empty print #.

examples.explanation: After "a": a. After "aa": none (#). After "aab": b. After "aabc": b.
a stays first until it repeats; then b, then c, then none.
